declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Hargrove Lane LLP supports preliminary approval. The settlement resulted from arm’s-length negotiations with Brightline’s counsel after the case survived a motion to dismiss. The $28 million class fund will be distributed automatically to identified members, without requiring claims. It represents 43.75% of the $64 million in disputed charges and provides relief now, avoiding the risks of class certification and trial and a further two to three years of litigation. The $5 million request for fees and expenses is separate from the class fund and subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the request; any amount the court does not award will go to the class. I do not disclose the parties’ confidential mediation communications in this declaration.
